as_read: Positive at 600 mg/day of root extract in small trials and pooled analyses with heterogeneity; named primary outcomes at that amount cover sleep and menopause, not the labels' mood and energy positioning.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index, body composition by DXA, Menopause Rating Scale
studies_to_add.quote: Twelve weeks of ashwagandha supplementation significantly improved sleep quality, menopausal symptoms, and body composition in postmenopausal women, with an excellent safety profile.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; COMPASS cognition assessed, others named as secondary
studies_to_add.quote: This study suggests that a dose of 600 mg a day can improve cognition, energy, and mood in adults with self-reported cognitive and energy problems.

studies_to_add.primary_endpoint: not named; anxiety, depression, stress and sleep quality
studies_to_add.quote: We found evidence supporting the effectiveness of Withania somnifera in treating anxiety symptoms.

stop_list: Both labels (204585, 274392) add fermented ginger 50 mg and a probiotic blend to the extract; the trials read are of the extract alone.
Neither label prints a brand. The 42742071 and 39498904 abstracts print no brand or withanolide content, so the labels' withanolides 30 mg can't be matched to them.
clinician_items: 41368179: this safety analysis reviewed case studies reporting liver toxicity and notes many involved supplements with both leaves and roots; read to the first 900 characters only.
41943502: no significant changes in liver function tests in 1002 adults on 600 mg/day root extract for 8 weeks.
stored_rating_note: positive_strong rests on one 64-person trial whose abstract names no primary outcome. The stored KSM-66 identity isn't in that abstract or on these labels. Stored record cites PMC3573577; not opened, since PMC ids here must come from the PubMed record.
unread_notes: Abstracts only. 41368179 read in part. Trials in athletes, children or at other amounts (41940566, 41599843, 39954269, 42602386, 41889719, 41846233) seen only in the listing and not used. Searches: 48 and 24 hits; 15 of each viewed.
